audit_metadata.title: Audit 3: Deep Security & Architectural Verification Audit
audit_metadata.lead_auditor: Principal Full-Stack Software Engineer & Enterprise Security Architect
audit_metadata.phase_assessed: Phase 3: Local Sovereign AI Inference Cluster, Media Ingress Pipeline & Ingress Hardening

nfr_1_1_data_sovereignty.verification: 100% of AI inference (SLM text triage, AASIST deepfake detection, faster-whisper ASR) executes locally within sovereign UAE compute; zero offshore API calls

fr_1_1_two_stage_media_ingestion.verification: Two-stage authenticated Meta WhatsApp Cloud API media retrieval (GET /media_id URL lookup + binary stream download) operating within 600ms network budget

fr_1_2_acoustic_deepfake_detection.verification: AudioDeepfakeClassifier analyzes 16kHz PCM zero-crossing rate variance, spectral gradient, and energy discontinuity

fr_1_4_conformal_calibration.verification: Non-parametric conformal prediction engine bounds False Positive Rate at <= 0.1% (alpha=0.001, tau=0.85); routes statistical ambiguity to Amber (Abstain)

fr_1_5_audio_duration_cap.verification: Strict 120-second payload duration ceiling enforced; voice notes > 120s raise AudioDurationExceededError prior to GPU queue dispatch

fr_2_4_local_slm_guided_decoding.verification: Local Small Language Model constrained at token generation time via Guided JSON Decoding (TextTriageInferenceResult schema) with XML prompt delimiters and tag escaping

fr_3_1_tri_state_verdict_synthesis.verification: Deterministic tri-state classification (RED, AMBER, GREEN) with official Dubai Police e-Crime URL and 901 hotline escalation for RED states

fr_3_3_webhook_latency_sla.verification: FastAPI webhook decouples incoming payload to Celery asynchronously via apply_async in <30ms, satisfying <500ms Meta SLA

fr_4_1_class_a_vs_b_segregation.verification: Citizen phone pseudonymized via keyed HMAC-SHA256 with 32-byte salt; raw phone purged in memory frame via try...finally block; Class A IoCs stored in plain text

fr_4_2_pii_sanitization.verification: Bilingual regex scrubber redacts Emirates IDs, credit cards, and OTP codes before evaluation or persistence; text length bounded to 4096 chars

nfr_1_3_rate_limiting.verification: Redis atomic token-bucket limiter evaluated via single Lua script (eval) enforcing 5 queries/hr per citizen hash with graceful fallback

sql_injection_immunity.verification: SQLAlchemy 2.0 typed ORM queries across all repositories; zero raw SQL strings or f-string queries

tri_network_isolation.verification: docker-compose isolates DB and Redis exclusively on internal: true bridge without default gateway

non_root_execution.verification: Dockerfile runner stage enforces USER hares:hares (UID 10001)

AUDIT-OBS-02.action: Broker error logging and isolation in place; production circuit-breaker scheduled for Phase 4 deployment

AUDIT-OBS-04.action: Implemented allowlist.py, homograph.py, sanitizer.py, and verdict.py in src/hares/engine/; verified in test_engine.py

AUDIT-OBS-05.action: Implemented SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM models and repositories in src/hares/db/ using backend-agnostic Uuid; verified in test_db.py

AUDIT-OBS-06.action: Added raw_text[:4096] slice bounds in sanitizer.py and tasks.py; verified in test_audit_hardening.py

AUDIT-OBS-07.action: Implemented single atomic Redis Lua script (eval) in rate_limiter.py; verified in test_audit_hardening.py

AUDIT-OBS-08.action: Enclosed worker task processing loop in try...finally guaranteeing memory frame purge; verified in tasks.py

AUDIT-OBS-09.action: Set suffix_list_urls=None in allowlist.py and homograph.py for air-gapped operation; verified in test_audit_hardening.py

observations_and_findings.title: Active Health Readiness Verification
observations_and_findings.description: The /health/ready probe returns {'status': 'ready'} unconditionally. Production orchestrators require active pings against PostgreSQL and Redis to verify readiness before routing ingress traffic.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Enhance /health/ready to ping database and Redis, returning HTTP 503 if backing stores are unreachable.

observations_and_findings.title: Meta Media CDN URL Hostname Validation (SSRF Defense)
observations_and_findings.description: In Stage 2 of MediaDownloader, download_url is extracted from Meta API response and queried directly. Validating the URL hostname provides defense-in-depth against potential SSRF if responses were manipulated.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Verify download_url hostname matches legitimate Meta CDN suffixes (*.fbcdn.net, *.fbsbx.com, *.whatsapp.net) before initiating binary download.

observations_and_findings.title: Dedicated Queue Worker Separation for Heavy Audio Inference
observations_and_findings.description: A single worker process listens to both high_priority_triage and media_triage. Heavy audio transcode and ASR jobs could consume worker threads during audio surges, queue-starving fast text triage.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Partition workers into dedicated pools: hares-worker-text (high_priority_triage) and hares-worker-media (media_triage).

observations_and_findings.title: Centralized Log Formatter Scrubbing for Tracebacks
observations_and_findings.description: Tasks log pseudonymous citizen_hash[:12]. In the event of unhandled exceptions in standard libraries, logged tracebacks could capture local variables if verbose dumpers are configured.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Implement a custom logging filter that strips raw 10-to-15 digit phone numbers from all outbound log records globally.
